Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Is sertraline the same as Zoloft?
:
Yes.
Sertraline is the active ingredient.
Zoloft is the brand name Sertraline is sold under in the United States.
Sertraline is the generic version of Zoloft.
The two contain the same medicine, sertraline hydrochloride.
You may also see sertraline written as sertraline HCl.
Is sertraline an SSRI, and how does sertraline work?
:
Yes, sertraline is an SSRI, which stands for selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
Nerve cells in the brain release serotonin to send signals.
Then, they reabsorb serotonin.
Sertraline blocks that reabsorption.
More serotonin stays available between nerve cells.
Sertraline has very little effect on norepinephrine.
Sertraline has very little effect on dopamine.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on adrenergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on cholinergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on GABA receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on histamine receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on benzodiazepine receptors.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "is generic version of", "Zoloft"]

The relation 'is generic version of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is the generic equivalent of the object drug.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has same doses as': The subject drug is available in the same dose amounts as the object drug.
B. 'approved for same uses as': The subject drug is approved for the same medical indications or therapeutic uses as the object drug.
C. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
E. 'is active form of': The subject drug is the active, ready-to-use form of the object drug.
F. None of the above.
